items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: And I stayed there and I worked with King. Well, he had Louis Armstrong was playing carnet.

ctx.x: He's a wonderful musician, he can play anything.

That's the first time I met Manuel then, out there. And so then I stayed there and I worked a while and I got the idea then that I liked it. Because I didn't like Cabaret Week. Before when I was working in the theaters and on the carnival shows and things, every city that I would be near or I played into, I would go, like at night, going out stepping, and I'd go to a cabaret. Well, as soon as they knew that I was singing, they'd ask me to do a number, they'd offer me a job. But, ooh, I didn't like that. I didn't…
